EstimateTask.System: You will be informed of the following context: user story name, ticket type, customer input request for this task, existing requirements and customer clarification questions. Your task: 1. Analyze given information and estimate story points for this task. Story points must be of Fibonacci type. 2. Estimate amount of time in hours to complete this task 3. Provide a list of justifications for your estimation. Explain in it why do you decided to set this amount of story points and hours. Summarize your justifications and make a list with 5 summarized and concise justifications
